title: A verifier change re-scores the data it affected, and people see the cases that matter
design_ref: A verifier is a product (change and re-score); Semi-automatic verification
purpose: Re-score every stored rollout of the red-team run with the strict verifier, and build the human review queue for that run within a budget of 40 items.

steps.display: vq.py job rescore-red -- rescore --run red-lenient --verifier math-final-answer@2.0.0 --out rescore/red-lenient
vq.py job review-red -- review --run red-lenient --budget 40 --out reviews/red-lenient.json
aws s3 cp s3://<bucket>/reviews/red-lenient.json -   # first five items
